evals.prompt: wrap Depth Anything 3 as a Durchblick node that publishes metric depth for the head camera
evals.expected_output: A node repository in the node pattern (uv project pinned to Durchblick, tools/setup.sh, console script, AGENTS.md), results stamped with the input's stamp, diagnostics, tested on a looped replay, with a measured baseline.
assertions: The depth carries the stamp of the colour frame it was computed from
The subscriber uses transport auto and the node offers --local and --max-hz
The node is run on a replay, not only on a live camera
A baseline rate and latency are measured before any optimisation
The node's options are parameters (declare_options right after parse_args, before the model loads), with its thresholds as live ones

Each change is measured against the same baseline input
